## What listeners single out

- The performance lacked Stu's final verse during the set [1]
- Lyrics were altered to include the phrase 'dancin' is good for ya' [1]

## The recordings

- **kglw2025-11-10.SBD** (recommended): soundboard; 0 songs; 148 min [1]

## Around the show

- Joey Smith shouted 'Free Palestine' at the conclusion of the concert [1]

## Tapers and lineage

- **kglw2025-11-10.SBD**: taped by Sam Joseph, Joseph Santarpia, Gaspard De Mulemeester, Grace Reader and Brandon DeLapp; source: SBD [1]. Also: The band's sound crew, including Sam Joseph, recorded the show [1]
